supersedes: sweep_plan.json (v1 design: box footprint into GroundingHead, M_hat scalars into the logit). The v1 V4-G run was stopped at 200/719 updates on request and is not reported (log in aborted_v1/).
budget: first 719 updates (= V4 epoch 1) of the sealed fold-0 schedule; LR curve over the full 1438; LAST.pt saved for every run
selection_rule: Among V4-GC candidates with model_val canonical AUPRC >= AUPRC(V4-G) - 0.01, pick the largest model_val energy_in_gt; ties within 0.005 -> smaller lambda. If none qualify, pick the smallest lambda and report it.
caveat: model_val has ~57 fractured canonical images; AUPRC SE ~0.04: screening, not evidence. TEST is not read.
after_training: scripts.mechanism_tests on model_val (M_hat vs box map, spatial permutation of M_hat, lesion occlusion)
